title: The models are basically tied — so why is one 69× the price? #ai
description:
Three top models — GPT-5.6 Sol, Fable 5, Kimi K3 — score 96, 95, 93 on the same coding benchmark. Basically a tie. But run the same task and the cost swings from 7 cents to 4 dollars 82 — a 69x spread for near-identical work. Everyone's still arguing which model is best. They converged months ago; raw capability is a commodity now. The edge moved up the stack: it's not which model you rent, it's the harness you build around it and the knowledge you feed it — orchestration, tools, evals, your proprietary context. Own that, and the model underneath becomes a swappable part. Rent the engine, own the car.
